findings.summary: Null shop on duplicate replay — wrong date in receipt modal
findings.detail: The maybeSingle() shop fetch ignores the error field. A DB error returns data: null, indistinguishable from 'no row'. On a duplicate-replay early-return, computeExpiryFromBase receives null and returns NOW + plan_duration, so the receipt modal shows the wrong renewal date. No data corruption — the shop row is never modified on a duplicate — but the display is misleading.
findings.action: Destructure the error field from the shop fetch. Log a warning when non-null. The NOW + plan_duration fallback can remain but should be an explicit logged decision.
